title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. nana
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. nana, commonly known as Dwarf Kidney Vetch, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family that is native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Kidney Vetch include soothing and protecting the skin, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. nana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
